name: Mortality Wanes
label: Quest
description: Deep within the hostile briars of Razorfen Kraul, a dying night elf named Heralath Fallowbrook whispers his final plea to passing Alliance adventurers.…
intro: Deep within the hostile briars of Razorfen Kraul, a dying night elf named Heralath Fallowbrook whispers his final plea to passing Alliance adventurers. Stripped of his strength and life, he asks only that his wife's stolen pendant of bonding be recovered and brought home to Darnassus alongside news of his demise.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have not long to live... So... So... Weak.
...the b-b-brave dwarf, Lonebrow, has been sent to w-w-warn Falfindel...
...my wife, Treshala... Her pendant of bonding to me... Stolen... By one of the f-f-foul aggressors...
Find it p-p-please... And return it to Treshala in Darnassus...
...along with w-w-word of my lonely... Death.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What brings you to my home, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: 'Tis not fair. Oh, cruel and intolerable world!
I must now carry this burden of grief and not let Heralath's work die with him.
You were brave to journey from such a dangerous place, friend. But please leave me now.
